steps.message: Create a playlist in Retro Music titled "Hip Hop Hits 332" with the following songs, in order: Twilight Calling, Lost in the Echo. Then export the playlist to the Downloads directory on the device.

Execute: adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i retro; content query --uri content://media/external/audio/media --projection _id:title --where \"title='Twilight Calling' OR title='Lost in the Echo'\"; content query --uri content://media/external/audio/playlists --projection _id:name"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i retro; content query --uri content://media/external/audio/media --projection _id:title --where \"title='Twilight Calling' OR title='Lost in the Echo'\"; content query --uri content://media/external/audio/playlists --projection _id:name""
